text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp was progressing 
smoothly.

"Or rather... she was showing results far 
beyond what was initially anticipated."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAHH!!
(THUD...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? L-Look where Gentil-san stepped...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Gyaaah! It turned into a crater!? 
This is a sandy beach, you know...!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
What is up with that person's power? 
That's totally insane...

"Her power, already extraordinary, had 
grown even further over the training camp. 
Still, it didn't mean she was handling it 
with ease."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew... Pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Two hundred ninety-five... ngh, two 
hundred ninety-six...!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Reset the count. We're starting over 
once more from the beginning.

No matter how blessed her physique, a 
crushing load that could never be handled 
with ease weighed down upon her. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, phew...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: One more to go, and then a break.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That would make the burden too light. 
Taking this on in my current condition is 
precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: There's value in this...! Ha...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Once spoken, I will see it through, even 
if I have to spit blood doing so."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —That's all it was.

She's strong. The source of that 
extraordinary power is... her unshakeable 
resolve, as I'm reminded once again.
choice_data_list: (I can't afford to fall behind either.)

text_block_list.text:
To grow as a Trainer during summer 
training camp, I was studying after 
training was over. I want to improve so 
much that it exceeds her expectations—
choice_data_list:
(We will see this through, no matter 
what!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Wait! Big sister, stoppoo~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, isn't it about time to take a 
break?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I've been running non-stop since morning! 
Actually, ever since this training camp 
started!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even for you, Big Sis, aren't you pushing 
yourself a bit too hard...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! Big Sis is gonna melt 
away...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you both. But please, don't worry 
about me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You should know by now. Your big sister 
isn't soft, you know.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Your sister is... stronger than 
"anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Why don't the two of you go eat some 
ice cream? Heh...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onee-chan, come on!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Big sis is strong too, so... Why did 
it... go that far...?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, about our next training session. 
Would it be alright if we changed it?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It's a tandem run.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Well, isn't this a rare sight.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To think that you would invite me to a 
training run together...
choice_data_list: (I have to admit, I was surprised……)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Over the course of the two Classic races, 
I proved to be a threat to you... Is that 
what you mean—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Are you quite finished?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to speak with me, there is a 
much better way to go about it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, I am well aware. That is 
precisely why I have been honing 
myself...!

Gentildonna is exceptional, of course, but 
Verxina is also a magnificent Umamusume. 
Which of them will claim victory in this 
showdown—

And yet, it was decided unexpectedly 
simply... and with absolute certainty.

Up to the 4th corner, Gentildonna ran near 
the front, while Verxina patiently waited 
for an opportunity to strike from behind. 
However, on the straight—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Hmphh!!

Gentildonna pulls away with ease. With a 
light spurt, keeping plenty in reserve, 
she goes on to—

She claimed victory without letting 
Verxina anywhere near her. —With a 
flawless run, as if driving home the vast 
difference in their strength.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...There's still... so much...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My line of sight was exceptionally clear.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Walking along a path with nothing in one's 
way is truly pleasant, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much for running 
alongside me. I learned a great deal from 
it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I hope that what happened today will not 
become— a regret of yours in our next 
race."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Do pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.
choice_data_list: Her spirit isn't broken at all.
Her spirit isn't broken at all, is it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"In plum bonsai, there is a technique 
called 'oridame.'"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The shock of snapping a branch stimulates 
flower bud formation... making the bonsai 
all the more refined, you see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"When we meet at the Shuka Sho, I am sure 
you will have blossomed into quite a 
beautiful flower."
choice_data_list: (Did she do that on purpose to push me?)

text_block_list.text:
That was a form of trust from 
Gentildonna... toward the struggling 
Verxina—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Stepping on soft mud offers no resistance. 
It is precisely by stomping through hard 
rock that true strength grows...

"...Perhaps it was thoughtless of me to 
call it a form of trust."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
About the afternoon menu, it'll need a few 
adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Taking our earlier tandem run into 
account, they'll decide on our next move.

"Tandem running uses more stamina than 
regular training. We should lower the 
intensity for a cool-down."

I was just reading up on a new training 
method recently. This might be a good 
chance to test it out.
choice_data_list: Training that'll make your muscles rejoice

text_block_list.text:
Recently, a new research paper on muscle 
hypertrophy was published by the Umamusume 
Training Research Society.
choice_data_list:
Looks like we can get greater results with 
less strain.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I did look over that paper, but I was 
skeptical whether it would yield the 
maximum effect.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Because my muscles... are quite 
demanding."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Very well. Let's give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Guts, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In other words... are you implying that I 
lack guts?
choice_data_list: It's not that I think so, but...

text_block_list.text:
I was reminded of her generation-mate, 
Gold Ship, and her wild, unconventional 
antics. A girl with unpredictable moves in 
a race—

It will definitely affect those around 
her. Gentildonna won't waver, but... even 
a 0.1-second hesitation is a huge loss.
choice_data_list:
So I can maintain my composure without 
wavering, even for 0.1 seconds!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is indeed a concern worth 
eliminating. Very well, let us give it a 
try.

And so, into the afternoon, we continued 
testing out the newly devised menu—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thank you, once again, for today.
choice_data_list: Take your time and get some rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Good work to you too."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It was a fulfilling, wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It seems you've been growing in your own 
way as well."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to tomorrow as well. To 
see just how strong your routine can make 
me."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well then, good night—
